task.title: Prove real paper runtime telemetry through reconciliation terminal readback

scope.owned_layer: Validation-first contract test proving real paper RuntimeTelemetryEmitter event ingestion through reconciliation-drift DriftReport persistence and terminal IncidentCase/OperatorPayload readback via official service endpoints.
not_changing: incidents service persistence implementation or ownership
live-capital activation, broker credentials, or RuntimeBinding authority

composes_with.upstream: RuntimeTelemetryEmitter (services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py) emits the real paper pnl_snapshot event.
composes_with.downstream: Evolution service consumes terminal incident identity (incident_id, binding_id, runtime_id) from IncidentCase OperatorPayload readback.

normal_path_proof.mode: deterministic, isolated in-process telemetry and reconciliation integration
normal_path_proof.trigger: One real paper pnl_snapshot event with avg_slippage_bps=12.5 (critical relative delta breach vs baseline 2.0).
event_sequence: RuntimeTelemetryEmitter.build_event() constructs a real paper-runtime pnl_snapshot event from RuntimeIdentity and binding resolver.

Reconciliation-drift consume endpoint accepts the event, evaluates avg_slippage_bps breach (12.5 vs baseline 2.0, critical threshold 1.0x relative delta), and persists DriftReport drift-evt-l12-telrec-001.

GET /api/reconciliation-drift/drift-reports?scope_ref=binding-l12-telrec-001 returns the DriftReport with correct binding_id, runtime_id, severity=critical, status=open, telemetry_event_ids=[evt-l12-telrec-001].
GET /api/reconciliation-drift/drift-reports/{id} returns full DriftReport detail including recommended_action and correlation_envelope.
POST /api/incidents/consume-drift-report consumes the DriftReport into IncidentCase with incident_id, binding_id, runtime_id.
GET /api/incidents/{id} returns IncidentCase with incident_id, binding_id, runtime_id, telemetry_event_ids.
GET /api/incidents/{id}/operator-payload returns OperatorIncidentPayload with incident_id, status=open, binding_id, runtime_id, is_open=true, postmortem_id=null, telemetry_event_ids.
Idempotent re-consume returns duplicate_event_ids=[evt-l12-telrec-001] and the same drift_report_id.

acceptance.statement: Real paper event emitted by RuntimeTelemetryEmitter is ingested via reconciliation consumer.
DriftReport is created and read back via official reconciliation endpoint GET /api/reconciliation-drift/drift-reports/{id}.
DriftReport is consumed into IncidentCase and read back via official incidents endpoints GET /api/incidents/{id} and GET /api/incidents/{id}/operator-payload.
Incident identity (incident_id, binding_id, runtime_id, telemetry_event_ids, severity, status, correlation_envelope, postmortem_id) is consumable for downstream evolution.
Validation-first: no patched HTTP, no direct downstream store writes, runs in parallel.
evidence_refs: services/reconciliation-drift/tests/test_l12_mfc_r4_telrec_001_contract.py - uses TestClient against real service FastAPI apps with in-process stores; no HTTP patching; parallelism-safe tempdir isolation

acceptance.statement: Idempotent re-consumption does not create duplicate DriftReports or IncidentCases.

commands.conclusion: 1 passed, 3 warnings (Starlette TestClient deprecation, FastAPI on_event deprecation — pre-existing)
12 passed, 3 warnings; test_incident_replay_suite.py excluded (pre-existing PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_URL env collection error unrelated to this task)

safety.no_live_capital: pass; the test event uses PANTHEON_RUNTIME_ROLE=paper, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MODE=paper, is_real_capital=False, is_real_order=False.
safety.incident_ownership: unchanged; test monkeypatches incidents store and reference_validator in-process only; no incidents service files modified.
safety.infrastructure: unchanged; no telemetry transport, ingest service, or infrastructure hardening files modified.

review.required_review: Verify: (1) RuntimeTelemetryEmitter builds a real paper event without patched HTTP; (2) reconciliation consume endpoint correctly classifies drift severity=critical from avg_slippage_bps breach and persists DriftReport; (3) DriftReport and IncidentCase readback via official endpoints include all required identity fields for Evolution; (4) idempotent re-consume returns duplicate_event_ids without new DriftReport; (5) no unrelated service or infrastructure files were modified; (6) test isolation is adequate for parallel execution. Approve through governed status command: AI_NAME=Antigravity REVIEW_FILE=docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-MFC-R4-TELREC-001/evidence.json $PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT/scripts/ai-status.sh approve L12-MFC-R4-TELREC-001 "<review decision>".
